verdict.rationale: OpenTofu advertises an ecosystem of 23,600+ modules and 3,900+ providers, plus centralized module version management. This supports consuming reusable modules from a shared ecosystem. However, the pack never names a public registry or documents how module sources are resolved, and nothing describes how a developer publishes a module; the closest item only mentions module authors writing code compatible with both OpenTofu and Terraform. missing for 10: explicit public registry documentation, a documented module publishing workflow, registry source/versioning syntax docs, independent hands-on corroboration of consuming registry modules.
